title: Uniquetings The Mod
description: Mod inspired by the uniquetings.aternos.me server
body:
Uniquetings The Mod

This is a fun mod inspired by the uniquetings.aternos.me server. The main goal of this project is just to have fun! I highly recommend playing this alongside other mods for the best experience.

Features

Basically, this mod adds a bunch of new materials and some really crazy gear:

  • Upgraded Items: Hot Coal, Hard Iron, Shiny Gold, Energetic Redstone, Lucky Lapis, Shiny Emerald, and Shiny Diamond. You craft these by putting 25 of the normal vanilla items together in a crafting table.
  • Super Shiny Ore & Block: You craft these using 15 of each of the upgraded items.
  • Gem Obliterator: A super fast pickaxe that comes with Efficiency 10.
  • Super Shiny Sword: A crazy strong sword with 56 damage, Sharpness 5, Fire Aspect 5, and Looting 5.

Why download this?

If you want to just have fun and get some crazy overpowered gear after grinding for ores, this is for you. It gives you a reason to actually use all the extra coal and iron sitting in your chests.

Recommendations

Make sure to use NEI (Not Enough Items) so you can actually see the crafting recipes in game, since they require specific amounts of items. And again, mix this with other mods!
